text: 1. Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with good conduct and with no criminal records and shall be in good health both physically and psychologically, excellent in academic performance, friendly to China and abide by the laws of the People's Republic of China and the discipline and regulations of Kunming Medical University. To apply as international students in bachelor's degree, Chinese immigrants in other countries shall present the valid passport or citizenship documents issued at least 4 years before and have lived at least 2 years (with 9 months being considered as one year, subject to the entry-exit stamp on passports) in foreign countries within last 4 years (counting to 30th April each year).2. Academic and age requirements:Applicants for bachelor's degree programs must hold a graduation certificate of the senior-high school or above and be from 18-25 years of age.3.Language proficiency requirements:Applicants for Chinese medium programs shall have the ability to join the professional studies in Chinese and bear the certificate of HSK 4 Chinese proficiency or above.
